note: Every input the 1G reference generator uses. Edit here and re-run `python tools/estimator-ref/generate.py` to regenerate all estimator vectors. Labels follow docs/build-plan/README.md Conventions. Values marked 'pending 1B' or 'pending 1C' are placeholders until those packages merge.

gravity.normalization: P4: a = (mu / r0^2) (r0 / r)^n, mu in m^3/s^2 = Newtonian-equivalent GM at r0, one shared fixed r0
gravity.label: ASSUMED
gravity.source: DECISIONS P4; r0 and masses from the 1B candidate scale (branch p1/1b-physics, unmerged). Pending 1B merge.

camera.label: ASSUMED
camera.source: IFOV/FOV from the DD05 test camera (25 mm lens, 3.45 um pixels, 2448 px); sub-pixel vs coarse limb processing after DD05; range floor is a play value bounded by DD05's ~1% prototype residual. Pending 1C.

starTracker.label: ESTABLISHED: S04 (8 arcsec pointing knowledge; tracking limits 0.3-3 deg/s); rate values ASSUMED at 1 deg/s

gyro.label: ESTABLISHED: S04 (0.15 deg/h bias stability, 0.02 deg/sqrt(h) ARW), converted to rad/s and rad/sqrt(s)

accelerometer.label: ESTABLISHED: S04 (0.02 (m/s)/sqrt(h) VRW, 3 ug bias stability); sample interval ASSUMED (Black Box rate)

truthShip.label: ASSUMED
truthShip.source: Scenario truth: engine 3% under nominal, 4 mrad thrust misalignment, 20 urad camera-to-star-tracker misalignment

muA.note: arrival calibration at r0, 2% off truth

windows.label: ASSUMED
windows.source: Tier L: a window closes after the bearing sweeps 0.7 rad (40 deg) or ln(range) spans 0.15, with at least 12 fixes. Scale-free, so independent of the 1B scale.

hedge.label: ASSUMED
hedge.source: Play value: outside the distance range the data covers, the law may deviate like an exponent change of +/-0.3. Owner/playtest may tune.

integrator.label: ASSUMED
integrator.source: Reference generator only. Truth integration checked against a 4x finer step (reported per vector).
